project_type: TypeScript/Node 22 CLI + static web site (GitHub Pages) with Z-machine game, vanilla JS web client compiled from src/web, src/theatre, src/render/plate.ts via tsconfig.web.json into web/js
build_system: npm scripts; build:site = tsx scripts/build-site.ts (tsc -p tsconfig.web.json, copies web/*.js, theatre/, fonts/, vendor/, js/ into _site). New web/card/ dir MUST be copied by scripts/build-site.ts and tsconfig.web.json include must list src/render/card.ts
build_command: npm run typecheck && npm run build:site
verification_instructions: npm ci; npm run typecheck; bash scripts/setup-tools.sh; npm run spike; npx vitest run; npm run build:site; npx playwright-core install chromium; npm run test:visual (scripts/ci/visual-qa.mjs); npm run test:a11y (needs CHROME_PATH). CI jobs: test, visual-qa, failsafe-guard (scripts/ci/failsafe-guard.sh), kiro-docs (npm run kiro:stats -- --check-links / --check-docs, hook evidence), pack-install.
snapshot_or_generated_files: tests/__snapshots__ (vitest -u to update after review); web/js is generated by build:web (check .gitignore); docs/img/card-*.png are screenshots to commit
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET. Full chromium may crash on crashpad in sandbox; prior work used chromium_headless_shell with swiftshader. Start servers in the same shell command as the browser harness. docs/KIRO.md, DEVPOST.md, BLOG.md have stats blocks checked by kiro:stats: re-run its update if counts change and the check fails.
contribution_requirements: Spec first in .kiro/specs/d3-creature-card/{requirements,design,tasks}.md (see .kiro/specs/live-raid for layout). Steering in .kiro/steering: blameless (no person/commit author; UI copy states actions, not prohibitions), failsafe, paste-flow, sla-policy, tech (record 3rd party code in docs/ATTRIBUTION.md), product (feature freeze Nov 27, no em dashes). One PR, do not merge.
key_patterns: src/render/plate.ts is a pure deterministic renderer (plateInput, PlateSegment, states Possessed/Rotting/Healed/Healthy, no fs/clock/random). web/live-exhume.js renders paste-your-repo result; web/raid.js handles raid end screen; web/theatre/font.js loads self-hosted JetBrains Mono from web/fonts. visual-qa.mjs checks CONTROLS overlap, monospace font, screenshots at 4 viewports.
directory_structure: src/ (render, web, theatre, exhume...), web/ (static site), scripts/ (+ci/), tests/, docs/, fixtures/, .kiro/{steering,specs}
